body:
Maya: Midnight heads-up — embeddings service (eu-west1) showing growing mem usage, reproducible in staging. I want to ship a tiny hotfix (kv cache flush frequency) asap. Can we fast-track? /cc @Alex @Sam
Alex: +1 on hotfix. What's the plan for rollout? prefer staged canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% with traffic cut if errors spike.
Maya: plan: build v2.3.7-hotfix, canary in eu-west1 first for 10% traffic, run smoke + perf for 15m, then expand. rollback knob ready. Need expedited approval during the midnight window (00:30-01:30 UTC).
Sam: I can be on-call for rollout. Quick checklist: release notes, pinned artifact, migration-free change, smoke test script.
Jen: I reviewed code change — tiny TTL tweak. No schema or DB migration. LGTM from my side.
deploy-bot: Deploy request created: /deploy start --service=embeddings --version=v2.3.7-hotfix --strategy=staged --regions=eu-west1 --initial-traffic=10% --auto-rollback=true
Maya: tagging release notes draft: https://releases.redwood.ai/drafts/embeddings-v2.3.7-hotfix — note: impact: reduced memory growth, no user-visible change.
ops-bot: Expedited-approval request: triggered. Required approvers: eng-release, oncall, platform-eng. Approvals so far: Jen.
Alex: Approving for expedited window. I sign off on canary -> ramp plan. :thumbsup:
Sam: Approving as oncall. I'll monitor logs and have rollback ready.
Maya: @deploy-bot please start canary when you have approvals. I'll kick off smoke tests after deployment starts.
deploy-bot: Approvals verified (Jen, Alex, Sam). Initiating canary deploy: step 1 -> 10% traffic in eu-west1. Logs: `/deploy logs --tail --service=embeddings --since=now-5m`
Maya: Smoke tests running: `./scripts/smoke_embeds.sh --region eu-west1` — initial latency looks stable, mem trending down a bit.
Alex: watching error budget and p50/p95. Set alert if 5xx > 0.5% or mem > baseline+15%.
ops-bot: Metric watch active. No alerts in first 10m.
Sam: After 15m, ready to expand to 50% unless objections.
Maya: expanding now to 50%: `/deploy promote --service=embeddings --target=50%`
deploy-bot: Promote accepted; ramp underway. Estimated completion 3m.
Jen: quick note for release notes: include rollback command and contact list (Sam, Maya, Alex).
Maya: Ramp complete. Post-ramp checks: smoke pass, mem trending to baseline, no uptick in 5xx.
Alex: green for 100% rollout. Any reason not to complete full rollout?
Sam: All good here. Proceed.
Maya: doing final promote to 100% now. `/deploy promote --service=embeddings --target=100%`
deploy-bot: Full rollout completed. Version v2.3.7-hotfix live in eu-west1.
Maya: publishing release note and tagging commits. Release note link: https://releases.redwood.ai/embeddings/v2.3.7-hotfix — please add any postmortem if anything odd shows up.
Alex: Thanks team. Good job moving quickly and safely.
Sam: Leaving monitor watch for next 2 hours. Ping me if anything. :eyes:
